answer: Crystal Epoch Memory Rule: each identity publishes a salted hash of its last-epoch action log; its next-epoch actions must replay consistently against that committed history, verified by random sampling of prior interactions. A farmed identity must maintain continuous, non-repeating behavioural history across epochs, and any fork reveals linkage. Attacker cost: sustaining many parallel histories with jade entropy and consistent fable traces, roughly linear storage and audit labor per identity.
